updates.prompt: Refer to the exhibit. R2 already runs OSPF area 0 on the inter-router link; all other neighbor requirements are compatible. Which R1 configuration both forms the single-area neighbor relationship with R2 and enables OSPF on R1's local 10.0.1.0/24 LAN interface?

options.label: A
options.text:
router ospf 100
 network 10.0.0.0 0.0.0.252 area 0
 network 10.0.1.0 0.0.0.255 area 0

options.label: B
options.text:
router ospf 100
 network 10.0.0.0 0.0.0.3 area 0
 network 10.0.2.0 255.255.255.0 area 0

options.label: C
options.text:
router ospf 10
 network 10.0.0.0 0.0.0.3 area 0
 network 10.0.1.0 0.0.0.255 area 0

options.label: D
options.text:
router ospf 10
 network 10.0.0.0 0.0.0.3 area 0
 network 10.0.2.0 0.0.0.255 area 0

updates.explanation:
C。10.0.0.0配wildcard0.0.0.3匹配R1互联口10.0.0.1；10.0.1.0配0.0.0.255匹配R1本地LAN，两者在area0启用OSPF。network命令匹配本机接口，不是把任意远端网段直接注入路由表。

A的0.0.0.252固定最低两位为00，不匹配互联口.1；B/D虽然第一条可启用互联口、形成邻居，但没有启用R1的10.0.1/24 LAN，不满足两个要求。B还将子网掩码误当wildcard；D的10.0.2/24是R2侧LAN。OSPF进程号10/100是本地标识，不要求两端相同，不能用进程号排除选项。

updates.prompt: Refer to the exhibit showing the current DR/BDR. The engineer plans a controlled fresh election in which all four routers participate with no existing DR/BDR declarations; R1, R3, and R4 retain priority 1. Which R2 configuration ensures that R2 wins that new DR election?
updates.explanation:
A。R2的Gi0/0设priority100，严格高于另外三台的1，在题设全员参与且无既有角色的初选中当DR。D仍为1，RID192.168.2.1低于R1的.8；B改.7仍低于.8，C改10.100.100.100也低于192.168.2.8。

OSPF不抢占既有DR，提高优先级本身不会替换当前R1；仅在R2重置进程也不能保证清除远端DR/BDR。本题明确另行协调重新选举，维护过程可能中断业务。当前角色不能单独证明历史选举顺序，优先级相同仅在相应选举比较时再用RID裁决。

updates.prompt: Refer to the revised topology and routing excerpt. R1 currently reaches 10.10.2.0/24 through R2. All shown peer addresses, downstream forwarding, and return routes are valid. Which command makes only destination 10.10.2.1 use R3 while other destinations in that /24 continue to use R2?
updates.explanation:
D。新增到10.10.2.1的/32主机路由，经R3的有效对端192.168.1.6；其余10.10.2.x不匹配/32，仍走OSPF/24经R2。主机路由比/24更明细，因此即使把它的AD改成115，也仍可在有效安装后优先转发该主机；不需要因OSPF而强求AD低于110。

A的/32指向R2，未让目标改走R3；B是/24 AD115，劣于同/24 OSPF110，不能建立所需主机特例；C的/24 AD100会替换整个OSPF/24，使其他主机也走R3。OSPF默认AD是110，115是IS-IS常见默认值，不要混淆。不同长度前缀的转发用最长匹配，同完整前缀竞争入表才比较AD。
